generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Compact Ultium crossover: 85 kWh pack. 2025 launched late in the model year as dual-motor AWD only; 2026 added RWD, more power and a native NACS port (port change only). Onboard charger 11.5 or 19.2 kW is a regulator option. One generation. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.cars.com/articles/2026-cadillac-optiq-gains-power-rwd-model-and-nacs-port-512041 ; https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/articles/2025-cadillac-optiq-pricing-specs-release-date
